capacity.json (Replicas and HPA): what each traffic level would take of the workload under test, from the per-replica SLO-max RPS and the per-replica sizing. Always written; rows is empty, with a reason, when the run has no SLO-max. capacity.csv holds the same rows.

Schema file: `schema/json/bundle/capacity.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `e6069c17f6fe`.

## Top level

| Field                   | Type                                                             | Required | Description                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `analyzer_version`      | `string`                                                         | Yes      |                                                                                                                             |
| `reason`                | `string`                                                         | No       | Why there are no rows.                                                                                                      |
| `rps_per_replica`       | `number`                                                         | No       | SLO-max RPS of one replica (analysis.json capacity.per\_replica). &gt; 0                                                    |
| `replica_headroom`      | `number`                                                         | No       | h\_rep: each replica is planned at rps\_per\_replica × (1 − h\_rep). ≥ 0; &lt; 1                                            |
| `gpus_per_replica`      | `integer`                                                        | No       | ≥ 1                                                                                                                         |
| `per_replica`           | `object`                                                         | No       | The recommended requests of one replica: the sum over the workload's containers.                                            |
| `is_scale_out_verified` | `boolean`                                                        | No       | True only when runs at two or more replica counts showed per-replica RPS within 10%; otherwise linear scale-out is assumed. |
| `rows`                  | array of [capacityRow](/reference/schemas/capacity/#capacityrow) | Yes      |                                                                                                                             |
| `caveats`               | array of `string`                                                | Yes      |                                                                                                                             |
| `infra_cost`            | [infraCost](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#infracost)        | No       | What a replica costs, which the rows' cost\_per\_hour multiplies (capacity\_model.json infra\_cost).                        |
| `token_cost`            | [tokenCost](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#tokencost)        | No       | Token cost per request at the SLO-max stage (capacity\_model.json token\_cost).                                             |

## Definitions

### capacityRow

| Field                  | Type      | Required | Description                                                             |
| ---------------------- | --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rps`                  | `number`  | Yes      | &gt; 0                                                                  |
| `replicas`             | `integer` | Yes      | ≥ 1                                                                     |
| `gpus`                 | `integer` | No       | ≥ 0                                                                     |
| `cpu_request_cores`    | `number`  | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                     |
| `memory_request_bytes` | `number`  | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                     |
| `cost_per_hour`        | `number`  | No       | Infrastructure cost when pricing is set. ≥ 0                            |
| `is_target_rps`        | `boolean` | Yes      | The row of analysis.target\_rps; its replicas are what the patches use. |
